profile.statementEn: My practice operates at the intersection of tectonic clarity, vernacular material intelligence, and climate-adaptive spatial systems. Grounded in computational design and physical prototyping, I explore how contemporary architecture can cultivate meaningful ecological dialogues between built form and territorial landscapes.
profile.statementZh: 實踐專注於構造清晰性、在地風土材料智慧與氣候自適應空間系統的交會點。立足於數位運算設計與實體原型製作，探索當代建築如何構建人造物與自然地景間深沉的生態對話。

education.institution: National Cheng Kung University (NCKU) / Department of Architecture
education.notes: Graduation Design Thesis: 'Topographical Thresholds: Post-Industrial Coastal Hydrology & Civic Pavilions'

education.degree: International Exchange Program in Sustainable Urbanism
education.notes: Focus on timber tectonics, passive building envelopes, and circular construction.

responsibilities: Led parametric modeling and daylighting simulations for a 4,000 m² cultural center competition in northern Taiwan.
Coordinated with structural and MEP engineering consultants on timber-concrete composite detailing.
Created physical 1:20 tectonic joinery models and client visualization decks.
Participated in historic masonry documentation and adaptive reuse site analysis.
Assisted in fabrication drawings and 1:1 scale bamboo bending prototypes for rural community art festival.
